notes.title: Star Drift Evolution - Early access release!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32011366/9e6925480c9fdeef2e7015d8d72bd488713c1ebb.png


Hi everybody!
Star Drift Evolution, the sequel to Star Drift, has launched on the 30th of October and we've been super busy with managing the after-launch!

GET IT HERE!
Star Drift Evolution


If you have Star Drift on your wishlist, please consider adding Evolution to your wishlist instead, because it's an improvement over Star Drift in any way you can conceive, also price-wise!

Evolution's regular price is less than 8 Euros and it's currently on sale at 10% discount! We know that Evolution was at least worth 11,99 Euros, too, but we really wanted for everyone to be able to jump in the game without second thoughts about the price!


IMPORTANT NEWS IF YOU ALREADY OWN STAR DRIFT:
Remember that until December 31st 23:59 CET, if you own Star Drift, you can receive a Star Drift Evolution Steam key for free! 

How to:
Just join our discord (https://discord.gg/gZqM6c9) and contact DeSangre about that, providing
- Your steam name
- Link to your steam profile
After checking your ownership, we'll provide you with a key for the new game.

Quick FAQ:
I want to support you guys by purchasing the new game without getting a free key for it even if I own Star Drift!
You would be so awesome that words could not describe it, and you would definitely help in making sure that Evolution's future is brighter.

Why should I buy Star Drift now? 
No real reason for that! Just directly buy Star Drift Evolution! That is the only game that will be updated from now on, anyway!

Thanks again for being interested in our game, and see you on Discord and on the Leaderboards!

notes.title: Star Drift Evolution release soon!
notes.notes:
**BIG NEWS** about the future of Star Drift: The sequel, Star Drift Evolution, will be coming out on Steam soon!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32011366/03e168080761972618322a35113cf0db835c5ec7.png


Hi Star Drift players and followers! :D

Big news today!

But before going into that, I suggest you to join our Discord channel, since it's pivotal for many initiatives and to stay up to date with the community :D
You can use this link to join: https://discord.gg/gZqM6c9


Star Drift Evolution page is up!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1005400


Past days have been hectic for the team, but... we now have a new steam entry and a release date for Star Drift Evolution: 30/10/2020!

This also means that from now on, the old Star Drift game will no longer be updated and probably at some point be reverted to the old [Legacy] version with islands and police chases. If you own Star Drift and, as promised in the past, want to get your free key for Star Drift Evolution, please contact Desangre (preferably) or Catze via private message on Discord, so you can already participate in the beta leading up to the release on the 30th.

Please note that Star Drift Evolution is the final name of what was called Star Drift 2 and/or Super Star Drift in past communications. We are really excited about this new chapter in the history of the game, and we definitely hope you will enjoy the game! 


Demo available

There now also is a small free demo available, where you can play 5 tracks with 5 cars. Just search Star Drift Evolution in the steam store and you should find it.

notes.title: Big 1.1 Update close to release!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32011366/69154e5148ef04d8f363173627d8edc261678890.png

Some last finishing touches are currently being added to the game, to prepare it for the release of the Big 1.1 Patch.
It features a new Campaign, new Tracks, new Cars, new UI, new Leaderboards to compete with friends, improved Physics and much more.

You can already try out the new features by joining the public Beta which is currently running: Just join our Discord Channel www.discord.gg/7aMVxVn and ask for access to the Beta. 

We invite all players to give feedback and make suggestions to ultimately bring Star Drift to a new Level!

notes.title: Update #8
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32011366/8a1054d6f12fa5a4841db41661b5d0b3f355c2bf.png


New Features:
- added a Handbrake (Spacebar or Gamepad B), it does not really slow you but lowers your rear wheel grip for better U-turns
- you can now press Space / Gamepad Y during Track selection to jump to the Hardcore version
- mapped the Angry Emoji to the left bumper on Xbox 360 Controller
- added a Pause Menu showing the game Options
- added Banner Ad Text customization to the Options Menu

Changes:
- improvements for less erratic countersteering
- made all suspensions softer for a cooler tilting effect during corners
- you now need to crash harder for your driver to go flying
- you can now reset your car on Hardcore
- replaced explosions with less exaggerated metal sparks
- removed AI car names for now until a better implementation is found

Fixes:
- you can now use Emojis in the Campaign
- Player Avatars fixed
- late joiners in Online Multiplayer should no longer spawn inside other player's cars
- cars should no longer stop on the finish line in Online Multiplayer
- Resetting your car in Online Multiplayer now changes your position instantly for all other players

notes.title: Update #7
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32011366/151fef34d272b7e1152c26843925469171b7e7d6.png


New Features:
- you can now change your Camera angle under Options
- you can now turn collisions on in Online Multiplayer (Beta)
- on Hardcore all Tracks now have a slight variation (different layout, new obstacles, reverse), these new Track variations can also be selected in Multiplayer
- each AI enemy now comes in the form of a specific driver with name, color and unique driving strengths and weaknesses
- added 'The Champ', a rare AI enemy who is very good and rewards a special car when you beat him
- added a new crash animation when crashing very hard
- AI cars now also deform when you crash into them
- the Loading Screen now shows the loading progress
- 8 Emojis are now mapped onto the Xbox 360 D-Pad and Right Stick
- Replay Ghost Cars are now transparent
- added an additional Lap Counter to the top left UI
- added 6 new Achievements
- experimenting with new crowded stands


Changes:
- you no longer take permanent Car damage on Hardcore
- improved Main Menu Intro
- removed weather and car headlight effects when playing on 'very low' quality settings
- turned car headlights off in already bright tracks
- gravity increased for jumps
- Online Multiplayer track selection time increased
- Emoji contrast improved

Fixes:
- fixed falling through the ground on several Tracks
- fixed a bug when ending a local multiplayer tournament, causing the tournament data not to reset
- Gamepad B will no longer immediately leave races
- cars should no longer be floating in the air when selecting a new track in Online Multiplayer

notes.title: Update #6
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32011366/5268e0b16fb30cbc626b1fc268fb7438f41e0d94.png


New Features:
- new Physics System: the ground type is no longer determined on a per Track basis, but instead can change dynamically (for example: if you hit the dirt border of Serpentines, you now lose grip)
- added a new Island with 5 new Tracks

Improvements:
- changed some Track layouts and added some (risky) shortcuts, reset personal and world records due to these changes, you might lose a Star or two :)
- your cars are now sorted by car model instead of order they are unlocked
- Netcode improved: enemy positions are now shown more accurately
- the dynamic handicap during a race now goes up faster (still same speed going down), handicap minimum threshold is now based on rank: 60% for 1st, 65% for 2nd, 70% for 3rd...
- after ending an online race, the next track is automatically selected to prevent accidentally playing the same track twice
- Crash FX improved
- visual improvements for many Tracks and the campaign world
- Track selection menu improved
- the car chasis now has more friction (when sliding on your roof or on the side)
- car sound improved in online multiplayer

Fixes:
- fixed a bug causing you to sometimes start with a Handicap in online races
- fixed a bug with the car headlights sometimes disappearing in online races
- fixed a bug with skidmarks sometimes not disappearing at the end of an online race
- fixed a bug with the chat window not closing after ending an online race
- fixed a bug causing hardcore campaign settings to transfer over to online races
- cars with special decals are now networked correctly
- writing a chat message containing an R will now longer reset your car
- sending a chat message with Enter will no longer cause you to log in the currently selected track

Fixes:

     added optional ingame music

     reworked the way you unlock new cars: each track now rewards you with one new car when you beat all of its 6 challenges

     improved the AI Cars visually
     various UI improvements (finish animation, bonus track unlock indicators)
     lowering the graphics quality now also lowers the amount of smoke particles (should greatly improve performance)

    Fixes:
     fixed a camera shake bug
